episodes.title: A New Pattern
episodes.summary: Cambridge student Edward Brooks starts working on a secret research project that triggers unthinkable chaos.

episodes.title: Syracuse
episodes.summary: Ed's work catches the attention of NSA operative Taylah Sanders and a mysterious institute.

episodes.title: The Sequence
episodes.summary: While retracing Safiya's steps, Ed uncovers chilling pleas from the past. Taylah tries to earn Ed's trust.

episodes.title: Kaplar
episodes.summary: Ed digs deeper for clues at the institute. Andrea navigates devastating news in Baghdad. Taylah reconnects with leadership.

episodes.title: House of Wisdom
episodes.summary: Ed and Taylah join Andrea in Baghdad, where they unearth ancient, buried answers—and get caught in the crosshairs of an unknown enemy.

episodes.title: The Last Link
episodes.summary: As the NSA trails their every move, Taylah and Ed race to track down the final piece of the puzzle.

episodes.title: Prime Finder
episodes.summary: Ed is coerced into completing his work. Taylah considers an ultimatum. An ally gets trapped in the middle of the mayhem.

episodes.title: The Key
episodes.summary: Season finale. As Ed and Taylah try to expose the truth, a deadly threat is discovered to be closer than they could have imagined.
